description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Might of the Moritoi — MORITOI ANCIENTS (WP-C46): a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT at starting strength has +2 OC; below starting strength its attacks re-roll hit rolls of 1; below half-strength they also re-roll wound rolls of 1. Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; the Contemptor-Achillus Dreadnought is engaged with the Meganobz); setup: P1 detachment Might of the Moritoi, CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation. First the undamaged Contemptor's OC reads +2 over its datasheet value; then (setup privilege) it is reduced to 1 wound (below half-strength) and the +2 OC is gone. Fight phase: both Pile In halves passed, a real click selects the Contemptor, all attacks at the Meganobz, resolved: the melee hit and wound blocks carry 'Moritoi Ancients' re-roll-1s entries in the modifier ledger and the Dice Log.

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description); the undamaged DREADNOUGHT has +2 OC
setup privilege: the Contemptor is down to 1 wound (below half-strength) — the OC bonus is gone
steps.script:
GameState.state.units["U_CONTEMPTOR-ACHILLUS_DREADNOUGHT_H"].models[0]["current_wounds"] = 1
var D = load("res://scripts/codex/custodes/CustodesDetachments.gd")
var u = GameState.state.units["U_CONTEMPTOR-ACHILLUS_DREADNOUGHT_H"]
return "%d %s %s" % [D.oc_bonus(u), D.below_starting_strength(u), D.below_half_strength(u)]

steps.comment: Moritoi Ancients named in the melee hit AND wound blocks' modifier ledgers
